tools.description: Rank catalog concepts by a full-text query. Optional structured filters narrow by concept type, tags (all-of), status, and trust tier.
tools.name: concept_search

tools.description: Content more-like-this: rank concepts by similarity to a seed concept's salient terms, excluding the seed.

bundle_id.description: Bundle id (required if the concept id is ambiguous across bundles).

tools.name: find_similar

tools.description: Traverse resolved internal links out from a concept, returning reachable concepts with their shortest hop count and path.

bundle_id.description: Bundle id (required if the concept id is ambiguous across bundles).

max_hops.description: Traversal depth (>= 1, default 2; capped by pgokf.max_graph_hops).

tools.name: concept_neighbors

tools.description: Fetch a concept's stored core fields (path, type, title, description, tags, resource, body text) by id.
tools.name: get_concept

tools.description: Fetch an Agent Skills package stored in the catalog: its name, description, package directory and hash, the complete SKILL.md frontmatter, the exact SKILL.md text, and the list of scripts, references, and assets it owns (build_workspace_plugin materializes the whole package byte for byte).

concept_id.description: The skill's concept id (its SKILL.md path without .md, e.g. skills/deploy/SKILL).

tools.name: get_skill

tools.description: List the targets a workspace plugin can be built for: agent-plugin (a portable Agent Plugins 1.0.0 directory with plugin.json, skills/, and mcp.json) and the per-harness layouts (claude-code, codex, copilot, hermes-agent, kimi, gemini-cli, cursor, agents, agents-md, ollama, generic), each with its kind (agent-plugin, skills, instruction-file, prompt-bundle, generic) and the documented directory it reads. An agent not listed is built with target 'custom' plus a harness description.
tools.name: list_plugin_targets

tools.description: Build an agent plugin from a catalog selection: an Agent Skills package (SKILL.md plus one reference file per concept), an AGENTS.md instruction file, an Ollama prompt bundle, or a generic index-plus-files tree, always with okf-workspace.yaml (the selection) and okf-workspace.lock (catalog snapshot and content hashes). Pass output_dir to write the tree into a workspace; otherwise the files come back inline.

all.description: Start from every visible concept (bounded by the limit) instead of nothing, so a selection narrowed only by types, tags, or a query - or by nothing at all - is expressible without naming a bundle.

base_model.description: Ollama only: the Modelfile FROM line (default llama3.1).

components.description: Extra parts: mcp (the harness's MCP server config for pgokf-mcp; the connection string is never written), guide (how to use the catalog: identities, trust tiers, MCP tools, JSON API), tools (okf.sh helper over the JSON API). Default: all three.

concept_ids.description: Include exactly these concept ids (within the selected bundles).

direction.description: With seeds: which way the closure walks relationships (default outbound).

harness.description: With target 'custom': the agent's display name, the kind of tree (agent-plugin, skills, instruction-file, prompt-bundle, generic; default skills), and for a skills package the directory the agent reads skills from, relative to the workspace root (for example .acme/skills).

hops.description: With seeds: how many relationship hops the closure walks (1..=8, default 2).

mcp_command.description: How the harness starts the MCP server (default pgokf-mcp). Alternative to mcp_url.

mcp_url.description: Point the harness at a pgokf-mcp --http endpoint (for example https://catalog.example/mcp) instead of a local stdio server. The bearer token is referenced, never written: the entry expands OKF_MCP_TOKEN where the harness documents an expansion form, names that variable where it documents one, and otherwise becomes a fragment to merge with a placeholder in it.

name.description: Package name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; default okf-knowledge).

picks.description: Specific files by identity, as 'bundle_id:concept_id' strings (a skill's SKILL.md id copies the whole package; a script or reference id copies that file). Picks are added to whatever the other selectors match and are never cut by the limit.

query.description: Full-text query (websearch syntax); results are ranked.

relation_types.description: With seeds: follow only these namespaced relationship types (for example 'docs:references'); empty follows every type. The names are the publisher's; the builder holds no vocabulary of its own.

require_closure.description: With seeds: refuse the build when the closure cannot be completed - a traversed relationship whose target is unresolved, or a closure node the stale policy would drop.

seeds.description: Closure seeds, as 'bundle_id:concept_id' strings: the build includes each seed and expands it through the catalog's typed relationships (requires the catalog's typed_relationships capability).

stale_policy.description: What to do with concepts the catalog reports as not fresh (default warn): warn keeps them, labelled - a banner on each reconstructed document, a generated <name>.stale-warning.md beside every exact-bytes file, which is never modified, and a top-level FRESHNESS.md - with states and reasons in the manifests; exclude drops them and refuses the build, enumerating the stale ids and reasons, when an exact pick, a seed, or a required closure node is stale, or nothing fresh remains.

target.description: A target id from list_plugin_targets, or 'custom' with a harness description for an agent the registry does not know.

title.description: Display title for the index (defaults to the name).

web_url.description: Base URL of the pgokf web UI, for the guide and the helper script.

tools.name: build_workspace_plugin

tools.description: Compare a built plugin's okf-workspace.lock with the live catalog: the pinned bundle generations, sync hashes, and freshness states against what the catalog reports now. Answers current, stale, retired, or unknown, with reasons per bundle. A downloaded plugin cannot update itself; rebuild it with build_workspace_plugin when this says stale.

lock.description: The full content of the plugin's okf-workspace.lock file.

tools.name: check_workspace_plugin_freshness

tools.description: List the bundles in the catalog with their id, name, kind (content: written through this API; filesystem: synced from a directory the database server reads), state, and file count. Use it to find the bundle name that put_document writes into.
tools.name: list_bundles

tools.description: Write one Markdown document into a content bundle, creating it or replacing the one at that path. The text is a complete OKF document: YAML frontmatter (type and title are required) then the body. Any 'verified' the document claims is set aside rather than believed - a verification is granted by a human approver reviewing it - and 'generated' is stamped with this token, so what you write is machine-generated until a person reviews it. The whole bundle is rewritten from the catalog's stored sources, so the catalog must keep them (store_source).

bundle.description: The content bundle's name (see list_bundles). Alternative to bundle_id.

bundle_id.description: The content bundle's id. Alternative to bundle.

path.description: Path within the bundle, ending in .md (for example runbooks/failover.md). It becomes the concept id without the extension.

text.description: The complete document: '---', YAML frontmatter, '---', then the Markdown body.

tools.name: put_document

tools.description: Remove one document from a content bundle. The rest of the bundle is rewritten unchanged; the document's history is not recoverable through this API.

bundle.description: The content bundle's name. Alternative to bundle_id.

bundle_id.description: The content bundle's id. Alternative to bundle.

path.description: The path to remove, as list_bundles' concepts and get_concept report it.

tools.name: delete_document
